T: New frat. Old mates. Dinner first.
D: Three men in their thirties start a fraternity at the house next to a college campus.
P: Serve the mains when Mitch-a-Palooza kicks off.
S: thin crispy patties, American cheese, pickles, onion and burger sauce, with Snoop Dogg on stage

Thin crispy smashed beef patties with melted American cheese, pickles, diced onion and burger sauce on soft slider buns, wrapped in paper. Roll 600g beef mince into 12 balls. Mix 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp mustard and 1 tbsp chopped pickles for sauce. Heat a griddle until smoking, smash the balls thin, season and cook 90 seconds, flip and top with half a slice of American cheese. Fill 12 toasted slider buns with patty, sauce, pickles and finely diced onion. Wrap each in a square of baking paper.
Crisp baked wings tossed in hot sauce butter and honey, blue cheese dip
Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp, tossed in hot sauce with melted butter and honey, blue cheese dip and celery.
Jalapeños stuffed with cream cheese and cheddar, wrapped in bacon and baked
Jalapeños halved and seeded, filled with cream cheese and cheddar, wrapped in bacon, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until the bacon crisps.
M: Dry rubbed brisket cooked 8 hours until it wobbles, with white bread and pickles
Brisket rubbed with salt, pepper and paprika, smoked or roasted wrapped at 140C for 8 hours until it wobbles, rested an hour, sliced thick. Pickles, white bread and barbecue sauce.
Frank's wedding chicken with mushroom sauce
breasts pan-roasted in butter and thyme, creamy mushroom and white wine, mash and green beans

Chicken breasts pan-roasted in butter and thyme with a creamy mushroom and white wine sauce, buttery mash and green beans. Season 4 chicken breasts and brown in 30g butter for 4 minutes a side, then roast at 200C for 10 minutes and rest. In the same pan fry 300g sliced mushrooms and a chopped shallot, add 125ml white wine and reduce, then 200ml cream and thyme and simmer 3 minutes. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter and milk. Steam 300g green beans. Slice the chicken and spoon over the sauce.
W: Chocolate tray cake covered in chocolate buttercream
Chocolate sheet cake baked at 175C for 30 minutes, covered in fudge frosting and sprinkles, cut into big squares straight from the tray.
K: Bourbon, lemon and peach nectar punch topped with cold lager

Bourbon, fresh lemon juice, peach nectar and cold lager stirred in a big bowl with ice, lemon wheels and mint, ladled into red plastic cups. In a big bowl stir 200ml bourbon, the juice of 4 lemons, 60ml sugar syrup and 500ml peach nectar. Just before serving, add plenty of ice and top with 750ml cold lager. Float lemon wheels and mint on top and ladle into red plastic cups.

steps.text: Dry the wings uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Bake at 220C until crisp.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and honey and toss the wings.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream to dip.
Serve with celery sticks.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the cauliflower and mash the blue cheese into the sour cream up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; batter and bake on the night

steps.text: Cut the cauliflower into bite-sized florets.
Whisk the flour, water and salt into a batter and toss the florets through.
Spread on a lined tray and bake at 220C, turning once, until crisp at the edges.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and honey, toss the cauliflower through and bake 5 minutes more.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream to dip.
Serve with celery sticks.

dishes.make_ahead: Fill the jalapenos up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; wrap in bacon and bake on the day

steps.text: Halve and seed the jalapenos.
Mix the cream cheese with the grated cheddar and fill each half.
Wrap in half a rasher of bacon each.
Bake at 200C until the bacon is crisp.

veg.n: Pledge week smoky eggplant jalapeño poppers
veg.make_ahead: Fill and wrap the jalapenos in the eggplant strips up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; bake on the day

steps.text: Halve and seed the jalapenos.
Mix the cream cheese with the grated cheddar and fill each half.
Slice the eggplant lengthways into 24 thin strips. Brush with the oil, paprika and soy and cook in a hot pan for 1 minute a side until bendy.
Wrap each jalapeno half in a strip of eggplant and hold with a toothpick.
Bake at 200C until the eggplant is crisp at the edges.

dishes.make_ahead: Cook the day before, slice cold and reheat

steps.text: Rub the brisket with salt, pepper and paprika.
Wrap tightly.
Cook at 140C until it wobbles.
Rest for an hour.
Slice thick and serve with white bread, pickles and barbecue sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Cook up to 2 days ahead and reheat

ingredients.item: young green jackfruit in brine (2 tins), drained

steps.text: Cut the hard core from the jackfruit and pull the pieces apart with two forks.
Toss with the onion, oil, salt, pepper and paprika.
Roast at 200C until browned at the edges.
Stir through half the barbecue sauce and roast again until sticky.
Serve piled on white bread with pickles and the rest of the barbecue sauce.
Beat part of the butter with the sugar, add the eggs, then fold in the flour, part of the cocoa and the milk.
Bake in a tray at 175C.
Cool.
Beat the remaining butter, icing sugar and cocoa, spread on and cover with sprinkles.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix the bourbon, lemon juice, syrup and peach nectar up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; add ice, lager and garnish just before serving

steps.text: Stir the bourbon, lemon juice, syrup and peach nectar in a big bowl.
Just before serving, add plenty of ice and top with lager.
Float lemon wheels and mint on top and ladle into red plastic cups.

af.make_ahead: Brew and cool the tea, then mix the base up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; add ice and the alcohol-free lager just before serving

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, remove and cool.
Stir the cold tea, lemon juice, syrup, peach nectar and vanilla in a big bowl.
Just before serving, add plenty of ice and top with the alcohol-free lager.
Float lemon wheels and mint on top and ladle into red plastic cups.

s.note: Crisp baked wings tossed in hot sauce butter and honey, blue cheese dip
s.how: Dry 1kg chicken wings in the fridge overnight. Bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Melt 60g butter with 80ml hot sauce and 1 tbsp honey and toss. Mix 80g blue cheese into 150g sour cream to dip. Serve with celery sticks.

s.note: Jalapeños stuffed with cream cheese and cheddar, wrapped in bacon and baked
s.how: Halve and seed 12 jalapeños. Mix 150g cream cheese with 60g grated cheddar and fill each half. Wrap in half a rasher of bacon, 12 rashers in total, and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until the bacon is crisp.

m.note: Dry rubbed brisket cooked 8 hours until it wobbles, with white bread and pickles
m.how: Rub a 2kg brisket with 2 tbsp salt, 2 tbsp cracked pepper and 1 tbsp smoked paprika. Wrap and cook at 140C for 8 hours until it wobbles. Rest an hour and slice thick. Serve with white bread, pickles and barbecue sauce.

w.note: Chocolate tray cake covered in chocolate buttercream
w.how: Beat 200g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 50g cocoa and 200ml milk. Bake in a tray at 175C for 30 minutes. Beat 150g butter, 300g icing sugar and 40g cocoa, spread on and cover with sprinkles.

d.note: Bourbon, lemon and peach nectar punch topped with cold lager
d.how: In a big bowl stir 200ml bourbon, the juice of 4 lemons, 60ml sugar syrup and 500ml peach nectar. Just before serving, add plenty of ice and top with 750ml cold lager. Float lemon wheels and mint on top and ladle into red plastic cups.
